EXPLICIT addresses one of the main challenges in the development of autonomous and intelligent systems: ensuring accountability and explainability in cyber-physical systems such as robots and intelligent vehicles. Description # Under construction. Project Reference # PID2024-162298OB-I00
Technologies # AI, Robots, Cybersecurity
Timeline # Starting date: 1 September 2025 Ending date: 31 August 2028 Funding # This project is funded by MICIU/AEI/10.13039/501100011033 and the European Union under grant PID2024-162298OB-I00.
